run_sphere_sim: run the sphere test module to generate synthetic views around a 3D object using argparse
create_vision_sim: create a vision_sim instance that sets up a pyrender scene with cameras and lights on a sphere
render_views: render color depth and segmentation images from a given camera pose index in the sphere simulation
save_dataset: save rendered sphere simulation data including images depths and poses to a pickle file
backproject_pointcloud: backproject depth images into 3D point clouds using camera intrinsics and poses
